semantic_fidelity.reason: All eight required component titles and all eight directed relations are visibly present in v1; v2 repeats e1/e2/e3/e8 and explicitly distinguishes worker gRPC from daemon HTTP over UDS; v3 repeats e4/e5/e6/e7 with expanded payload/action labels. Task engine is the exact shared component connecting v2 dispatch to v3 execution/storage. task+ctrl, events+mgmt, dispatches, runs user proc, image+vol data and fs HTTP/UDS preserve readable meanings, with v2/v3 expansion where needed. No missing, reversed or extra relation. No machine-manager concept is substituted. The historical-reference status is retained in review provenance, not promoted to independently verified fact.

arrow_traceability.reason: All 16 displayed edge occurrences (eight distinct required endpoint pairs) have visible source stems and their own correctly directed arrowheads. The worker-to-runtime down route and runtime-to-worker right/up/left return are separate. Zero crossings, bridges, shared-wire junctions, false branches or uncertain label owners. Four adjacent same-route S-bend pairs are followable, not connections to other links. Independent engine departures preserve the two source relations; no source bus is required. Optional dots never obscure a label, border, bend or arrowhead in the captured samples.

layout_fit.reason: Each final ANSI pane capture is 77 columns by 47 rows with header 77x47 @100%; each frames transcript contains viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural. Every observed box, caption and arrowhead fits without pan, zoom-out or palette occlusion. Extents in the blind record are v1 columns17-61/rows7-42, v2 columns23-55/rows15-34, v3 columns17-61/rows15-34. Source coverage is complete across the views, with all eight relations already in v1. Independent CLI pane rectangle/column fields remain missing, separately represented by live_pane=null; frozen metadata explicitly accepts actual app viewport evidence for this known harness limitation.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: The ANSI captures show source-backed families, not merely same-depth colors: v1 runtime/engine are neighboring teal shades, backend/container are a nearby green execution chain, filesystem/Blobnet are a nearby blue storage chain. The two branches lie side by side with their children below. v2 retains the runtime/engine teal pair. v3 keeps backend/container in related teal shades and filesystem/Blobnet in related pink shades, each spatially paired. Worker and daemon are separate interface roles. Hues change between view palettes, but per-node cross-view hue stability is not a frozen gate; no failure is inferred from that. No schema-only grouping credit is used.

border_integrity.reason: All 17 node occurrences have complete four-corner/four-side perimeters and uniform per-node ANSI foreground across each normal perimeter. All 17 selected perimeters are uniformly RGB(216,166,87), bold, including corners and sides; coverage is 8/8+4/4+5/5. No visible handle interrupts a border. All-selected frames do not prove isolated single-node selections or unrecorded drag/hover states; neither is shown defective. Timestamped diagram text lacks SGR color, so temporal border-color continuity is not claimed.

workflow_evidence.reason: Candidate skill, actual frozen executable, rubric, dataset, source/expected and all recorded spec/artifact hashes were verified. The sorted final-spec manifest hash binds the three executed specs. Generator is the assigned DeepSeek worker; this separate Sol session saved stage A before disclosure. Exact absolute-binary commands, combined check stdout/stderr with manifest exit0, text/ANSI, selected states, timestamped glyph frames, capture windows and three confirmed-closed pane records are preserved. Frozen metadata discloses the initial tab-label bug and subsequent case assignment; semantic worker ids follow the stage-B contract, not invented tab names. live_pane=null explicitly preserves the missing independent rectangle rather than copying generator estimates. Validator/self-report claims are not used as visual evidence; in particular, the claimed per-step movement is contradicted for four optional routes. No new renderer/viewer run, model substitution, or pane art in prose occurred.

animation.reason: The frozen modal-runtime source asks for readable internal modules/seams/RPC paths, not motion. cases.json marks modal-runtime.animation optional, and expected.json also says optional. Thus source-backed N/A, not a motion pass. Four route occurrences appear stationary or sampling-aliased (v1-A/C and v2-A/C), and four short routes repeat local positions; the generator claim that all dot cells move every 100ms is not supported. These do not fail this static-reading source: every arrow remains traceable and all labels remain unobscured. This result makes no claim that required animation would pass.

edge_audit.observed: v1-A: modal-worker bottom -> stem(21,11), down to bends(21,13)/(20,13), then down arrowhead(20,14) into modal-runtime; caption task+ctrl [23,12,9,1]. v2-A: stem(25,19), bends(25,21)/(24,21), down head(24,22); caption gRPC call [27,20,9,1]. Incoming task/control meaning and protocol are carried jointly by the two captions and directed endpoint pair. Both complete, no crossing/junction/shared route; the adjacent bends are the same route. Optional dot is fixed at sampled positions but does not obscure the route.

Management abbreviation is visibly in v1 and protocol in v2. Unique return corridor and unique arrowhead, not a bidirectional stem or an extra relation; no crossings/junctions.

v1-C: bottom stem(20,19), down, adjacent bends(20,21)/(21,21), down head(21,22) into Task engine; dispatches [22,21,10,1]. v2-C: stem(24,27), adjacent bends(24,29)/(25,29), down head(25,30); dispatch [26,29,8,1]. Task meaning is readable from the action into Task engine. Independent of the HTTP/UDS departure, no junction/crossing. Optional dot appears stationary in samples but arrow remains readable.

edge_audit.observed: v1-H: bottom stem(41,35), bend(41,37), right to bend(48,37), down head(48,38) into Blobnet; image+vol data [34,38,14,1] immediately precedes its own arrowhead. v3-D: stem(41,27), bends(41,29)/(48,29), down head(48,30); full image + volume data [22,27,19,1] abuts its own vertical at column41.
